Name: NPC-LuRen English Translation
Author: HydrangeaGardenTea
Description:
This is an English translation of the Custom NPC mod created by [url=https://kym2020.tumblr.com/]KYM2020[/url], who was given permission by the original mod author to translate it and
then they gave me permission to upload their translation. The original mod by yuki9977 is over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18013]here[/url].

[b]Installation Guide[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract NPC LuRen_Boy (1.6) from the original mod page
[*]Download this mod and let it overwrite the original mod files
[/list]
[b]A brief introduction (that I copied and pasted from the original mod page):[/b]
LuRen lives in the deserted community center (or in the backwoods in the update). They claim to be entrusted by your grandfather to take care of you and to give you some help.
You have hardly seen them deal with people other than you, they have no job, but can conjure various items for you.
They are always worried that they won't be able to help you, and will often give you something. However, although they takes care of you, their attitude is polite and distant. In your eyes, LuRen can be called a weird person.
After you get acquainted, LuRen by will share their stories with you, and you will realize that they are not a human being or even a person from this world...

[b]Events[/b]:
     0 Hearts: Enter Lu Ren's home.
     2 Hearts: After receiving the letter, go to the community center from 6:00 am to 7:00 pm, the weather is sunny, and there's 6 empty slots in your inventory.
     4 Hearts: Beach, between 9:00 pm to 2:00 am, the weather is rainy, not winter.
     6 Hearts: Bathhouse, any time, any weather. (After seeing the 4 Hearts event)
     8 Hearts: Beach, from 6:00 am to 7:00 pm, the weather is sunny, not winter. (Experienced 4-heart and 6-heart heart events)
     10 Hearts: Forest, from 0:00 am to 2:00 am, the weather is sunny. (Experienced 6-heart events)
     14 Hearts: South of Ginger Island (the place where you first landed on the island, the location of the beach resort), from 6:00 am to 6:00 pm, the weather is sunny, not winter.

[b]FAQs[/b]:
[b]Is this mod compatible with SVE?[/b]
I don't even use SVE so I can't test it lol. Should be compatible for the most part since their home is at the backwoods.
